sections.h2: The subsidy rises in slabs to 3 kW, then stays at ₹78,000

chart.title: The subsidy stops growing at 3 kW, so bigger systems get no more
chart.source: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana central financial assistance slabs.

sections.means: The central subsidy is a fixed slab, so a 5 kW or 10 kW household receives the same ₹78,000 as a 3 kW one.

chart.title: Pace has risen: one lakh households now takes under eight days
events: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana launches
3.16 lakh installations, the strongest month since launch

sections.means: Installations have accelerated, with the time to add one lakh households falling from 118 days to under eight.
